question: Barlow & Ross (2025) propose Proto-Tomoip-New Ireland, with Tomoip and Proto-New Ireland as coordinate branches; Ross (1988) derived Tomoip from New Ireland. Are the nodes entered?
chosen_reading: No: Tomoip is entered under POc with POc > Tomoip rows (Table 3). No New Ireland language and no Western Oceanic or Meso-Melanesian node is in the data, so a PTMNI or PNI node would have no other daughters. Its innovations (*p > *p, *v; *k, *q > *k > *k, *ɣ) are in the lect notes.
alternatives: Add Proto-Tomoip-New Ireland (and Proto-New Ireland) under POc with the split rows of Tables 4-5, and Tomoip under it.

question: Table 1 (p. 332) prints the final-vowel header as -a -e -e -i -u.
